Players Committee card image of [[Leia Organa (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Agenda: rebellion. May not be 'choked.' Gains [Republic] at Galactic Senate. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (if with an Imperial leader, may add one destiny to total power or attrition instead). 'Diplomatic' immunity to attrition < 3.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/leiaorgana.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
